group.passage: When Taiwan's high-speed rail began carrying passengers in January 2007, it changed the way people traveled along the island's west coast. The line runs about 345 kilometers from Taipei in the north to Kaohsiung in the south. Before it opened, the trip took about five hours by regular train or by bus. An express high-speed train, which stops only once on the way, now makes the same trip in about 90 minutes. Between stations, the trains reach almost 300 kilometers per hour. The chart below shows how many passengers the high-speed rail has carried each year since it opened. In its first year, the high-speed rail carried 15.6 million passengers. The number of daily trains kept rising during that year, and in 2008 the total almost doubled. The new trains also drew travelers away from planes. Within a year, some flights between cities in Taiwan lost more than half of their passengers. After that, ridership kept climbing at a steady pace. In 2015, some trains began stopping at new stations in Miaoli, Changhua, and Yunlin, and by 2019 the yearly total had reached 67.4 million. Then the COVID-19 pandemic arrived, and fewer people traveled in 2020, so the company ran fewer trains for a while. In May 2021, when Taiwan raised its COVID-19 alert to level 3, ridership took a nosedive. The total for 2021 fell to 43.5 million, the lowest level since 2011. The drop did not last long, however. As pandemic rules were relaxed, people quickly returned to the trains. In 2023, the high-speed rail set a new record with 73.1 million passengers, and the number has kept growing since then. In 2025, it carried 82.1 million people, more than five times as many as in its first year. These numbers show how quickly the high-speed rail has become a part of daily life for many people in Taiwan.

translation_zh.text:
台灣高鐵在 2007 年 1 月開始載客時，改變了人們在島上西海岸旅行的方式。這條路線從北部的台北延伸到南部的高雄，全長約 345 公里。在高鐵通車以前，這趟路搭一般火車或客運大約要五個小時。現在，中途只停一站的高鐵直達車，大約 90 分鐘就能走完同樣的路程。在兩站之間，列車時速接近 300 公里。下面的圖表顯示高鐵通車以來每年載運的旅客人數。
通車第一年，高鐵載運了 1,560 萬人次。那一年每天開出的班次不斷增加，到了 2008 年，總人數幾乎翻倍。新的列車也把旅客從飛機那裡吸引過來。不到一年，台灣有些城市之間的航線就少了一半以上的乘客。在那之後，搭乘人數穩定攀升。2015 年，部分列車開始停靠苗栗、彰化和雲林的新車站；到了 2019 年，全年總人數已經達到 6,740 萬人次。
接著新冠肺炎疫情來襲，2020 年出門旅行的人變少，公司因此有一段時間減少班次。2021 年 5 月，台灣把疫情警戒提升到第三級，搭乘人數突然大幅下跌。2021 年全年人數跌到 4,350 萬人次，是 2011 年以來最低的水準。
不過，這次下跌並沒有持續很久。隨著防疫規定放寬，人們很快又回到列車上。2023 年，高鐵以 7,310 萬人次創下新紀錄，之後人數持續成長。2025 年，高鐵載運了 8,210 萬人次，是第一年的五倍以上。這些數字顯示，高鐵多快就成為台灣許多人日常生活的一部分。

checked.claim: The high-speed rail began carrying passengers in January 2007; the line runs about 345 km from Taipei to Kaohsiung.（f1、f2；Wharton 2007-09 原頁一致）
Before it opened, the trip took about five hours by regular train or by bus.（f4；第 2 題正解的依據；Wharton 原頁一致）

An express high-speed train, which stops only once on the way, now makes the same trip in about 90 minutes.（f3 是 Wharton 2007 年 9 月報導的當時情形；文中用 now 寫成現況。2026 年現況：直達車停靠南港－台北－板橋－台中（－台南）－左營，台北到左營之間至少停 2 站；最快的是 2026 年 2 月新增的 1985 車次（停板橋、台南），台北－左營 95 分鐘〔自由時報 2026 報導；工商時報 2026-01-31〕。「只停一站」不符現況）
Between stations, the trains reach almost 300 km/h.（f5）
In its first year it carried 15.6 million; in 2008 the total almost doubled.（f11、f12；d1：15.555656、30.581261）
The number of daily trains kept rising during that year.（f15：19 班→46 班）
Within a year, some flights between cities in Taiwan lost more than half of their passengers.（f6；Wharton：some competing routes plummeted more than 50%）
In 2015 some trains began stopping at new stations in Miaoli, Changhua and Yunlin; by 2019 the yearly total had reached 67.4 million.（f7、f11；Taipei Times 2026-08-02 原頁一致）
Fewer people traveled in 2020, so the company ran fewer trains for a while; in May 2021, when Taiwan raised its alert to level 3, ridership took a nosedive.（f8、f9）
The total for 2021 fell to 43.5 million, the lowest level since 2011.（f11、d1：2021＝43.46；2011＝41.63，2012–2020 都高於 43.46，說法正確）
In 2023 a new record of 73.1 million; the number has kept growing; in 2025 it carried 82.1 million, more than five times the first year.（f10、f11、f13、d1：2024＝78.25；交通部公布 2025 年 82,070,618 人次，與 d1 一致）

problems: 第一段 “An express high-speed train, which stops only once on the way, now makes the same trip in about 90 minutes.” 與現況不符：事實單 f3 取自 Wharton 2007 年 9 月的報導（當時情形），選文用 now 寫成現在的事實。2026 年高鐵直達車在台北與左營之間至少停 2 站（板橋、台中或板橋、台南），最快台北－左營 95 分鐘（2026 年 2 月新增的 1985 車次）。這句也是第 2 題誘答 B（About 90 minutes）的出處，須改寫選文（例如改成 “When it opened, an express train … took about 90 minutes” 或拿掉「只停一站」）並在事實單 f3 標明是 2007 年的情形後重生。
